cc:Work.dc:title: Shelf - SBCMicroRack
cc:Work.dc:description:
Stackable rackable racks for SBC Pi-Style Computers
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes SBCMicroRack --sbcs 3 --stable 1 --switch 1 --clearance_z 30 --hole_diameter 3 --thickness 4 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes SBCMicroRack --sbcs --stable --switch --clearance_z --hole_diameter --thickness --reference --labels
